---
title: "2. PETPrep"
---

[PETPrep](https://github.com/nipreps/petprep) preprocesses PET data. It corrects for head motion, registers the PET images to the participant's MRI, and extracts time-activity curves (TACs) from FreeSurfer regions. A full run takes hours per participant, so you look at outputs that have already been computed for this dataset.

## Look at the reports

PETPrep writes one HTML report per participant. To open a report, run:

```bash
/neurodesktop-storage/course-material/pet/scripts/view_petprep.sh sub-01.html
```

The script prints a link. Open it in a new browser tab. When you are done, press Ctrl+C in the terminal. To see a list of all reports, run the script without a filename.

The surface-based analyses (petsurfer) have one report per session:

```bash
/neurodesktop-storage/course-material/pet/scripts/view_petsurfer.sh sub-01_ses-baseline.html
```

While you read the reports, think about these questions:

- How would you check that the PET-to-MRI registration worked?
- What do the motion estimates tell you?
- Which outputs would you use for kinetic modelling?

## Look at the outputs

The outputs are in `~/pet_course/derivatives/petprep`. Open one participant's folder. For example, find the TAC file `sub-01_ses-baseline_desc-preproc_seg-gtm_tacs.tsv` and open it in JupyterLab. What do the rows and columns contain?

## Try to run PETPrep

PETPrep is run through a small Python wrapper called `petprep-docker`. Install it and look at its options:

```bash
pip install --user petprep-docker
petprep-docker --help
```

You can ignore the pip warning that `~/.local/bin` isn't on your PATH.

Now try to run PETPrep on one participant:

```bash
petprep-docker /neurodesktop-storage/course-material/pet/data/ds004869 ~/pet_course/petprep_test participant --participant-label 01
```

It fails. Read the error message, and then use `petprep-docker --help` to work out:

- What is missing, and what would you need to make this run?
- PETPrep runs FreeSurfer, which needs a licence. Which option passes the licence file?
- This dataset already contains FreeSurfer outputs in `derivatives/freesurfer`. Which option would let PETPrep reuse them, and why would that help?
